name: Band Shoulder Internal Rotation in Neutral
steps: Anchor a resistance band at elbow height.
Stand sideways to the anchor point with your target arm closest to the anchor.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees and hold the band handle with your forearm rotated outward away from your belly.
Keeping your elbow pinned to your side (with a small towel roll for feedback), rotate your forearm inward across your stomach.
Hold for one second against your belly, then slowly allow the band to rotate your forearm back out.
coaching_cues: Keep your wrist straight and firm without curling it as you pull inward.
Keep your shoulder blade retracted and depressed, avoiding forward rounding.

sources.attribution: Cornell Health Shoulder Band Strengthening Protocol
